headlines.title: 专家：现房销售更强调“所见即所得”，契合存量房时代运行逻辑
headlines.summary: 浙江工业大学中国住房和房地产研究院院长虞晓芬介绍，现房销售，则更强调“所见即所得”，契合存量房时代运行逻辑。过去数十年我国住房供需缺口大，预售制度充分发挥了加速住房供给、快速回笼资金的优势，有效缓解了城镇化快速推进阶段的住房供给短缺矛盾，适配了行业高速发展需求。但当前我国住房市场格局已发生根本性转变，城镇居民人均住房建筑面积已超过40平方米，存量市场、增量市场供给充足，二手房销售面积占比过半，房地产发展目标需要从规模转向质量，市场主要矛盾已从“有没有”转向“好不好”，行业发展逻辑彻底重构。国家推进现房销售，是顺应市场的演化趋势，适配供求关系发生重大变化的

headlines.title_en: Experts: Cash-sale housing emphasizes 'what you see is what you get,' aligning with operational logic of existing-home era
headlines.summary_en: Yu Xiaofen, dean of the China Housing and Real Estate Research Institute at Zhejiang University of Technology, noted that spot sales emphasize 'what you see is what you get,' aligning with the operational logic of the existing-home era. Over the past decades, China faced a large housing supply-demand gap, and the presale system fully leveraged its advantages in accelerating housing supply and swiftly recovering funds, effectively easing the housing shortage during rapid urbanization and matching the industry's high-speed development needs. However, the current housing market landscape has fundamentally shifted: per-capita residential floor space in urban areas exceeds 40 square meters, both existing and new supply are ample, second-hand sales account for over half of transactions, and development goals must pivot from scale to quality. The main market contradiction has shifted from 'having or not having' to 'good or bad,' and the industry's operational logic has been thoroughly restructured. Promoting spot sales aligns with market evolution trends and adapts to the major changes in supply-demand relations.

headlines.title: 房贷延至最多40年后个人能否贷这么长？有银行称或放宽年龄限制
headlines.summary: 8月28日，住房城乡建设部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局出台一系列政策，涉及个人住房贷款、商品房开发贷款等多个领域。 新规还明确，个人房贷最长期限从30年延长到40年，为我们买房贷款提供了更多选择。 说到这里，记者要提醒一点，银行贷款是有年龄限制的。以建设银行为例，银行要求借款人年龄+贷款期限一般要小于等于75岁，最多可以放宽到80岁。所以，房贷延长到最多40年后，能不能贷这么长，您还得问问银行。记者也第一时间打听了一下，有银行表示，今后有可能会放宽个人房贷的年龄限制。（央视）

headlines.title_en: After mortgage extension to max 40 years, can individuals borrow that long? Some banks may relax age limits
headlines.summary_en: On August 28, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the People's Bank of China, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration introduced a series of policies covering personal housing loans, commercial housing development loans, and other areas. The new rules also clarify that the maximum term for personal mortgage loans is extended from 30 to 40 years, offering more choices for homebuyers. However, reporters remind that banks impose age limits on loans. For example, China Construction Bank requires that the borrower's age plus the loan term generally not exceed 75 years, with a maximum extension to 80. So, with mortgages extended to up to 40 years, whether such long terms are available depends on the bank. Reporters quickly checked and found some banks indicating they may relax mortgage age limits in the future. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: CSRC acts! Real estate firms' 'refinancing to repay old debt' finally breaks ice; new real estate development model arrives
headlines.summary_en: [CSRC acts! Real estate financing 'refinancing existing debt' finally breaks through, new development model for property sector arrives] In the view of interviewed senior investment bankers, the two most direct benefits for real estate companies among the five financing measures are: first, corporate bond issuance for developers is no longer limited to the years-long 'refinancing existing debt' model but can include new issuance for projects meeting policy requirements; second, support for listed developers to raise funds via private placements and directional convertible bonds. The first measure marks an opening for additional bond issuance beyond refinancing, significantly boosting the feasibility of new issuance for eligible developers.

headlines.title: 中金点评杰克逊霍尔会议：迟到的鹰派，信誉的修复
headlines.summary: 中金指出，美联储主席沃什在杰克逊霍尔的讲话态度偏鹰：他承认通胀仍然偏高、明确利率仍是主要政策工具，并表态将“视情况需要采取行动”；同时以经济韧性、就业稳定、金融条件宽松为依据，说明当前政策风险更偏通胀一侧。他还将65个月通胀超标的责任归于央行自身，纠正了7月“让市场代替美联储加息”的模糊表态。中金认为，这次讲话有助于重建美联储的公信力，讲话过后，市场也开始交易政策信誉的边际修复。长期层面，沃什仍坚持AI可能重塑经济与政策框架，并继续推动减少前瞻指引等改革议程。对市场而言，本次表态提升了美联储年内加息概率，但即便如此，也未必是纯粹利空。当前市场并不缺流动性

headlines.title_en: CICC commentary on Jackson Hole meeting: Late hawkish turn, a repair of credibility
headlines.summary_en: CICC noted that Fed Chair Warsh's speech at Jackson Hole leaned hawkish: he acknowledged inflation remains elevated, affirmed rates as the primary policy tool, and pledged to 'act as needed'; he also cited economic resilience, stable employment, and loose financial conditions to argue that policy risks skew toward the inflation side. He attributed the 65-month inflation overshoot to the central bank itself, correcting the ambiguous July stance of 'letting the market replace the Fed in raising rates.' CICC believes the speech helps rebuild Fed credibility, and markets have begun pricing in a marginal recovery in policy credibility. Over the long term, Warsh still insists AI could reshape the economy and policy framework and continues to push reforms like reducing forward guidance. For markets, the remarks raise the odds of a Fed rate hike this year, but that may not be purely bearish; markets are not short on liquidity.

headlines.title_en: CCB President Zhang Yi: Enhance mortgage coverage and service levels
headlines.summary_en: Zhang Yi, president of China Construction Bank, said on August 28 at the bank's 2026 interim results conference that looking to the second half, the bank is confident in China's long-term economic fundamentals but is also clearly aware of challenges ahead and will maintain strategic focus. He mentioned full support for expanding domestic demand, industrial upgrading, and the growth of private and small-micro enterprises, enhancing cross-border integrated service capabilities, closely following national consumption-boosting policies, improving mortgage coverage and service levels, deeply participating in major consumption-promotion activities, and deepening inclusive livelihood financial services. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: SF Holding: Accelerate deployment of smart equipment and AI application scenarios
headlines.summary_en: SF Holding said at its August 28 results briefing that for the second half of 2026, domestically, it will continue to tap into diverse consumption segments, deeply serve B-end enterprise transformation and upgrading, and further widen its operational moat; internationally, it will seize opportunities from Chinese companies' brand and capacity going global to accelerate the growth of its second growth curve. Meanwhile, it will accelerate the deployment of smart equipment and AI application scenarios, converting technological advantages into long-term operating gains. Overall, external uncertainties such as oil prices persist in the second half, and the company will maintain strategic discipline, continue lean management, and strive to deliver stable revenue and profit results. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 9月港股通标的调整进入倒计时，警惕爆炒“入通”概念股
headlines.summary: 9月港股通标的调整进入倒计时，新一轮标的纳入名单也成为市场关注焦点。业内专家提醒，随着港股通调整生效节点临近，投资者需要高度警惕“入通闪崩”的投资风险。尤其要留意那些基本面偏弱、股权高度集中的个股；同时南向资金以及被动型基金产品，也应当做好相应的风险防控。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: September Stock Connect southbound target adjustments enter countdown; beware of speculation on 'inclusion' concept stocks
headlines.summary_en: The September adjustment of the Stock Connect targets is nearing, and the latest list of inclusions has become a market focus. Industry experts warn that as the adjustment takes effect, investors should be highly vigilant about the 'inclusion flash crash' risk, especially for stocks with weak fundamentals and high ownership concentration; southbound capital and passive funds should also take corresponding risk-control measures. (Securities Times)

headlines.title_en: ChangXin Memory Technologies sues US Department of Defense
headlines.summary_en: According to comprehensive foreign media reports, on August 28 local time, Chinese chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Defense demanding removal from a blacklist. Per Bloomberg, CXMT said its chips are designed for civilian and commercial use, not military, and claimed it was wrongly blacklisted. The suit was filed with the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also named as a defendant. In a statement after filing, CXMT said it is not a military enterprise and that its reputation and business interests have been continuously damaged since its initial blacklisting in January 2025, adding that the action was taken to protect commercial interests. Per Reuters, the Defense Department said in a statement that 'as a matter of policy, the department does not comment on pending or ongoing litigation.'

headlines.title: 交通银行副行长周万阜：今年活期存款实现同比多增
headlines.summary: 交通银行副行长周万阜在交通银行2026年半年度业绩说明会上表示，从存款期限结构看，定期化趋势仍然没有明显的改变，存款的增量中大部分还是来自于定期存款。周万阜同时强调，交通银行今年的活期存款已实现同比多增，带动了整个存款成本下降。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Bank of Communications Vice President Zhou Wanfu: This year, demand deposits saw a year-on-year increase
headlines.summary_en: Zhou Wanfu, vice president of Bank of Communications, said at the bank's 2026 interim results briefing that in terms of deposit term structure, the trend toward fixed deposits remains largely unchanged, with most deposit growth still coming from time deposits. Zhou also stressed that BoCom's demand deposits have grown more year on year this year, helping lower overall deposit costs. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 上半年全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户，同比增长7.0%
headlines.summary: 市场监管总局今天（29日）公布数据显示，上半年，全国新设外商投资企业3.5万户，同比增长7.0%。 从投资区域看，出口大省、沿边省份外商投资企业增长“双轮驱动”。上半年，海南、山东、广东、江苏等出口大省新设外商投资企业增速分别为38.6%、15.2%、8.1%、6.8%；黑龙江、内蒙古、广西、吉林等沿边省份新设外商投资企业增速分别达到79.5%、29.1%、16.6%、12.0%。（央视）

headlines.title_en: In H1, new foreign-invested enterprises nationwide reached 35,000, up 7.0% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the State Administration for Market Regulation today (29th) show that in the first half, 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were registered nationwide, up 7.0% year on year. By investment region, export-heavy provinces and border provinces drove growth in new foreign-invested enterprises. In H1, Hainan, Shandong, Guangdong, and Jiangsu saw growth of 38.6%, 15.2%, 8.1%, and 6.8%, respectively, while border provinces like Heilongjiang, Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, and Jilin posted growth of 79.5%, 29.1%, 16.6%, and 12.0%. (CCTV)

headlines.title: 国家发展改革委员会宏观经济研究院研究员刘琳：土地财政减退为推进房屋销售制度改革提供了时机窗口
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委员会宏观经济研究院研究员刘琳表示，今年1-7月全国土地出让收入同比减少30.8%，对地方财政贡献继续大幅降低，这为推动房屋销售制度改革提供了时机窗口。商品房屋销售制度改革要求新供地项目和已购土地但未取得工程规划许可证项目，单体建筑完成主体结构封顶，才可预售，且鼓励优先选择现房销售方式。

headlines.title_en: Liu Lin, researcher at the National Development and Reform Commission's Academy of Macroeconomic Research: The decline in land finance opens a window to advance housing sales system reform
headlines.summary_en: Liu Lin, a researcher at the National Development and Reform Commission's Academy of Macroeconomic Research, said land sales revenue fell 30.8% year on year from January to July, sharply reducing its contribution to local finances, providing a window to advance housing sales system reform. The reform requires that for newly supplied land projects and existing land parcels without construction permits, presales are allowed only after the main structure of individual buildings is topped out, with spot sales encouraged as the preferred option.
